sections.content: Use para, para que and con el fin de to explain purposes and objectives.

items.english: We study in order to improve our Spanish.

items.spanish: Salimos temprano para que no hubiera problemas.
items.english: We left early so that there would be no problems.

items.spanish: Organizaron varias reuniones con el fin de escuchar todas las opiniones.
items.english: They organised several meetings with the aim of listening to every opinion.
